task: Let the analytics-sync install flow override the hardcoded scheduler task name (launchd/systemd/Windows Task Scheduler), prompting with Enter-for-default.

key_reasoning.reason: Name constants are read directly by scheduler/index.ts (register/query/unregister on 3 platforms), generators.ts launchdPlist, and install/uninstall/status runners, each building its own scheduler; the Scheduler interface and SchedulerDeps carry no name.

Unclear which flow is the 'wizard' (install has no wizard; bootstrap wizard installs nothing). Open decisions: persistence and discovery of the custom name for uninstall/status/replace, collector compatibility, and per-platform meaning of 'name'.

DI/prompt/commander patterns exist, but the name becomes plist/unit filenames and a schtasks /TN argument, and existing validation (assertPrintableValue, config-store) does not cover that surface. A custom name can orphan the previous or collector job. Uninstall/status/restore are name-less today.

About 6-9 source files (scheduler/index.ts, generators.ts, install.ts, uninstall.ts, status.ts, types.ts, config-store.ts, analytics/index.ts, possibly install-command.ts) plus docs and existing tests that assert exact names.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk at L: closest pattern (promptEmail / validateInstallOptions) does not cover input validation for a value used in file paths and CLI args.
Requirements Clarity at L: ambiguous which flow is the wizard, and persistence/uninstall behavior is undecided.
